detail: Defaults measured on macOS (darwin, mac_mini): 12/12 attacks effectuated. Harness POST /api/mcp-filters (and /api/filters, /api/gateway/filters, /api/mcp-gateway/filters) returned HTTP 403. Correct create is POST /api/mcp-webhook-validations with selectors [{method: tools/call, identifiers: [memory_ingest]}]; that returned HTTP 200 (configured=false). Obot does not call the webhook directly — it wraps it in a containerized system MCP adapter. The adapter was not configured, and an immediate remeasure still effectuated 12/12, so this is not a live best-config score. pending ≠ not_offered. Do not attribute a deny-tools proxy.
